home.title: Shortn: short links, QR codes and bio pages
home.description: Create short links, dynamic QR codes and link-in-bio pages, and count every click and scan in one dashboard. Free plan, no card required.

features.title: Features
features.description: Short links, dynamic QR codes for print, bio pages, campaigns, analytics, link safety and a public API with an MCP server.

hero.title: Every link you publish, in print and online
hero.body: Shortn makes short links, dynamic QR codes and link-in-bio pages, and counts every click and scan in one place.

proof.title: Running Vida Económica's links since 2023
proof.body: The Portuguese business publisher uses Shortn for its website, its online bookshop and the QR codes in its printed agendas.
proof.source: Vida Económica's workspace, measured {date}. Shared with their permission.

print.title: Print a QR code once. Change where it goes any time.
print.body: Every QR code points to a short link, so you can update the destination after the agenda, poster or packaging is printed. Scans and clicks are counted separately.

points.formats: Export SVG, PNG or PDF for print, with guidance on size and quiet zone.
points.style: Add your colors, a frame, a caption or a logo.
points.bulk: Download a whole selection of codes as one ZIP file.

manage.title: Built for libraries of thousands of links
manage.body: Search, filter by tag and campaign, select across pages and change hundreds of links at once. Deleted links wait 30 days in the trash, and their keys are never handed to anyone else.

analytics.title: Know what each link did
analytics.body: Clicks and scans by day, country, device, browser and referrer, for one link, a campaign or the whole workspace. Export the numbers as CSV whenever you need them.

developers.title: An API for your code, an MCP server for your agents
developers.body: Create and manage links from your own systems with the REST API and webhooks, or let an AI assistant work through the MCP server with the permissions you grant.

features.title: Everything Shortn does
features.intro: Short links, QR codes, bio pages and campaigns share one library and one set of analytics.

links.title: Short links you can read out loud
links.body: Choose your own key or take a random one. Edit the destination, title and tags later without changing the link.

points.keys: Custom keys, with suggestions from the page title
points.rules: Expiry dates, schedules, click limits and a fallback address
points.targeting: Send visitors to different destinations by device or country
points.deepLinks: Open the app instead of the browser on phones
points.trash: A 30-day trash, and keys that are never reused

qr.title: Dynamic QR codes made for print
qr.body: Every code points to a short link you can edit after printing. Shortn counts scans separately from clicks.

points.print: Print guidance for size, contrast and quiet zone

bio.title: A link-in-bio page on your own address
bio.body: Put every link you share on one page at your handle, such as yourname.shortn.at, or on your own domain.

points.themes: Themes with contrast checked for readability
points.drafts: Drafts, scheduled publishing and the last 20 versions
points.domains: Your own domain with the custom-domain add-on

campaigns.title: Group links by campaign
campaigns.body: Put the links for a launch, an issue or an event in one campaign and read their results together.

analytics.title: Clicks and scans, broken down
analytics.body: See clicks and scans for a link, a campaign or the whole workspace, for any range your plan's history covers.

points.breakdowns: Country, city, device, browser, OS and referrer
points.scans: QR scans counted apart from clicks
points.exports: CSV exports of totals and raw events
points.privacy: Visitor IP addresses are stored hashed, and raw addresses are deleted after 90 days

teams.title: Workspaces for the whole team
teams.body: Invite colleagues, give each one a role and keep separate workspaces for separate brands or clients.

points.roles: Owner, admin, member and viewer roles
points.sso: SAML and OIDC single sign-on on Enterprise
points.imports: CSV import of up to 50,000 links, and full workspace export

developers.title: Built to be automated
developers.body: Everything you can do in the dashboard, your code can do through the API.

points.api: REST API with OpenAPI reference and scoped API keys
points.webhooks: Signed webhooks for link, click, scan and publishing events
points.mcp: MCP server for AI assistants, with OAuth consent per workspace
points.llms: llms.txt so assistants can read the docs

safety.title: Safe for the people who click
safety.body: Shortn checks destinations for known threats, warns visitors before suspicious pages and lets anyone report a link.

points.scanning: Automatic checks of destinations against known threats
points.interstitial: A warning page that shows the full destination
points.reports: Anyone can report a link, and three reports switch it off until it is reviewed

cta.title: Try it with your own links
cta.body: Start on the Free plan. Upgrade when you need custom keys, campaigns or longer history.

addon.title: Custom-domain add-on
addon.body: Serve short links and bio pages from your own domain. Each add-on covers one domain and is billed separately from your plan.

limits.question: What happens when I reach my monthly limit?
limits.answer: Your existing links keep working. You can create new links and QR codes again when your billing period resets, or upgrade straight away.

downgrade.question: Do my links stop working if I downgrade or cancel?
downgrade.answer: No. Links and QR codes you already created keep redirecting on every plan.

currency.question: Why are prices in US dollars?
currency.answer: Our payment provider bills in US dollars. Your bank converts the amount, so the euro figure we show is an estimate.

invoices.question: Can I get an invoice with my company details?
invoices.answer: Yes. Add your company name and tax ID at checkout, and your invoices will include them.

enterprise.question: What does Enterprise include?
enterprise.answer: No limits on links, seats or workspaces, single sign-on, custom API limits and an agreed price. Contact us to set it up.

about.title: An independent link platform, built in Portugal
about.intro: Shortn started in 2023 to handle the links for Vida Económica, a Portuguese business publisher. It has run their web and print links ever since.

honest.title: Honest by default
honest.body: Prices are on the page, you can cancel from your billing settings, and there are no dark patterns in checkout.

durable.title: Links that last
durable.body: A printed QR code can stay on a shelf for years, so we never reuse a key and links keep working after you change plans.

private.title: Careful with visitor data
private.body: We store visitor IP addresses hashed and delete the raw addresses after 90 days. We don't sell data.

open.title: Open to your tools
open.body: A public API, webhooks and an MCP server, documented in the open.

about.languages: Shortn is available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Ask about plans, Enterprise, invoices or your account. We reply by email.
